# Apt packages for the Sanitizers (sanitizers) CI job.
# One package per line; comments starting with # are ignored.

ninja-build
nasm

# lld-22 keeps the linker in the same LLVM major as the
# apt.llvm.org clang-22 installed below; ld.bfd/gold pulls in
# a system-wide LLVM 16 gold plugin that can't read clang-22 LTO
# bitcode (Unknown attribute kind 91 in LLVM 16 reader). Using lld
# keeps the linker in the same LLVM major as the compiler.
# libclang-rt-22-dev ships the ASan/UBSan/TSan runtime libraries
# (libclang_rt.asan.a etc.); without it clang-22 emits instrumented
# code but lld-22 can't resolve __asan_*/__ubsan_* symbols.
clang-tools-22
libclang-rt-22-dev
lld-22
libzimg-dev
